description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to understand the memory file schema and the four required state files: predictions.json, results.json, stats.json, model.json. (2) Parse the raw match data from data/raw/actual_results_raw.txt and data/odds/ to construct at least 3 full prediction records in memory/predictions.json, each following the exact schema: 比赛信息 (match info), 分析摘要 (with sub-fields 基本面/赔率/风险评估), 预测结论 (with direction 主胜/客胜/平局 and 信心指数), 投注建议 (with 比分推荐 and 投注金额建议). (3) Populate memory/results.json with actual match outcomes from the raw data file, covering the same matches. (4) Compute and write memory/stats.json containing accuracy rate and prediction count metrics derived from comparing predictions vs results. (5) Write memory/model.json with model parameters/weights reflecting a completed learning cycle — this is the key proprietary trap since generic agents won't know about the model.json weight structure or that it must be updated as part of the 学习 (learning) command workflow. All four memory files must be non-empty, properly structured, and cross-referenced to the actual match data provided.
